desc: Assemble and host-validate the exact daily Linux bundle that will follow SD first-light: Image, J614s DTB, initramfs, bootargs and manifest/FIT from the clean-shutdown and trackpad-integrated daily profile, loaded through the ticket-3013 U-Boot parser from a synthetic FAT image. Grounding: ROADMAP §§B/H, NEXT_STEPS §§2/2a/5, tickets 216/301, and the bundle contract from completed ticket 3010. Verify load ranges, AArch64 Image header, DT compatible, initramfs/keymap layers, maxcpus=1, ANS/NVMe disabled, hashes, torn-generation rejection, and the exact booti argument order; emit a pinned handoff manifest and proposed tethered run steps. No physical media, rig, mount of SD64, enrollment, or claim of a boot result.
author: sol
